content:
The Comedy Central program shared on social media a supercut of GOP candidates lavishing praise on Donald Trump and thanking him for his support during their 2026 midterm campaigns.

They all went on to lose as the GOP was routed in the elections.

“Let’s go around the table and see what the GOP was thankful for this year,” the show captioned the montage, which featured the likes of Sen. Darline Graham (R-S.C.), Rep. Mike Lawler (R-N.Y.) and Sen. Jon Husted (R-Ohio).
